name: 06-after-picking-chrome
js: (() => { const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('#spbEasyRail .spb-easy-finish')]; if(!cards.length) return 'NO CARDS'; const name=(cards[0].querySelector('.spb-easy-finish-name')||{}).textContent; cards[0].click(); return 'clicked:'+name; })()

name: 07-one-color-at-a-time
js: (() => { const b=document.getElementById('spbEasySideByColor'); if(!b) return 'NO SIDE DOOR'; b.click(); return 'entered by-color'; })()

name: 08-full-catalog-families
js: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#spbEasyRail button')].find(x=>/FULL CATALOG/.test(x.innerText)); if(!b) return 'NO TOGGLE'; b.click(); return 'opened full catalog'; })()

name: 09-spec-map-revealed
js: (() => { const b=document.getElementById('spbEasySpecPeek'); if(!b) return 'NO PEEK'; b.click(); return 'spec map on'; })()
